description: Add Inkling 2 Mini as a selectable local model in OpenAgents Desktop (models.coax, models-checks.coax, Window+Dialogs.swift).

steps.send: Add Inkling 2 Mini (`inkling-2-mini`) as a selectable local model in OpenAgents Desktop (#13825): add `coder_page_set_inkling`, `coder_page_model_inkling`, and `cp_is_inkling` in `apps/openagents-desktop/page/models.coax` (and state/picker wiring in `page/state.coax` and `page/checks/models-checks.coax`). Verify with `coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only model`.

graders.run: grep -q coder_page_set_inkling apps/openagents-desktop/page/models.coax && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only model
